parsed.rationale: All four members are `type-alias-object` declarations with empty `fields_or_signature` lists and no structural evidence (jaccard, shared_field_count, and shared_ancestor are all null). The cluster_id signals a name-collision query rather than a semantic-duplication query. Three of the four records live under `Tests/` paths (`RadioPlayerControllerTests.swift`, `PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockAudioSession.swift` ×2, `SoundPlayerTests.swift`), and the context flags — notably `is_mock: false` and `is_test: false` — appear to be mis-classified by the pipeline rather than reflecting true production code, given the file paths clearly sit inside test/mock directories. Without field or method evidence to confirm shared shape, the name collision alone is insufficient to justify a refactor; the coincidence of the name `MockAudioSession` across two separate packages (`Playback` and `PartyHorn`) is expected for independently authored test doubles.
